end.line: Quillon for Sato Lindqvist’s cross-border M&A team

vo: Sato Lindqvist runs data rooms of up to twenty thousand documents, with red-flag reports due in seventy-two hours.
Load the data room into Vault. Every document is read at once, and change of control terms come back flagged.
Ask the Assistant, and every answer is cited to the page, with the source clause open beside it.
In Word, Quillon marks up the S-P-A to each client's playbook, so every redline matches their risk appetite.
Priya will walk your team through it on Wednesday the twenty-sixth.
